tools.name: show_checklist_results
tools.description: Use this when the organizer asks how far along a shared checklist is, what is overdue, who did what, or what is left, for a checklist made with create_shared_checklist. Takes the private organizer link and returns progress by section and by person, overdue and due-today items in the checklist's time

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_shared_checklist, update_shared_checklist · Private data: create_shared_checklist, show_checklist_results, update_shared_checklist · Public sink: create_shared_checklist, update_shared_checklist · Destructive: update_shared_checklist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_shared_checklist, update_shared_checklist · Private data: create_shared_checklist, show_checklist_results, update_shared_checklist · Public sink: create_shared_checklist, update_shared_checklist · Destructive: update_shared_checklist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
